mandate: Owner report 2026-10-16: "I had an odd experience with a particularly long comment thread where the review tab drawer view wouldn't let me scroll any further down and I couldn't read the rest of the thread except by going to Discuss." Detail: the Comments drawer, reached from Threads.
governing_rfc: RFC-BPR-0028 (BPR-1290's inline Comments drawer, BPR-1293's Threads)
root_cause: diff_workbench::line_rect, the drawer's only line geometry, used QPlainTextEdit::blockBoundingGeometry, which Qt computes exactly only within about one viewport above (two below) the first visible block and otherwise answers with a stand-in near where its walk stopped; a long thread's line scrolled a drawer's height above the code stopped moving while the code scrolled on, so the thread's foot never came into the drawer.
fix: line_rect uses exact_row_rect (BPR-1476's keyboard_row_rect, renamed): measured axis line origins in two panes, row stride in one.
